title: Weighted energy bounds for the growing Airy kernel
source_hypothesis: Small fixed strict-glancing collar and convex conic frequency patch, lambda>=1, exact boundary argument b=-mu*lambda^(-1/3), zeta=b-q*lambda^(2/3)*d with smooth positive d, invertible boundary mixed generator, finite matrix amplitudes of orders 0 and -1/3. Smooth errors and exact weak conormal use the actual CAA transport amplitudes and original operator. Inputs are frequency-side weighted coefficients.
